summary: Declare ownership of the existing Planfile Python package before MCP repair

delivery.outcome: The application workstream owns the existing planfile/** package, allowing governed source repairs such as GitHub #71.
nonGoals: No source behavior change, dependency update or alteration of active ticket-068.

architecture.decision: Repair a target-owned manifest omission through the integration workstream before application implementation. Add only the existing Python package root to application ownership; preserve standard-owned base and all admission/publication gates.
architecture.rollback: Revert the manifest change; application repair then remains pending ownership admission.

validation.evidence: Pending validation and independent exact-head review.
